Print a ctsem model

Source: R/print.ctStanModel.R
print.ctStanModel.Rd

Prints a summary of the model: its type, the parameters it will estimate, and its individually varying parameters.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'ctStanModel'
print(x, matrices = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A model from ctModel.

matrices

Whether to print the model matrices. Defaults to TRUE for models small enough to read.

...

Ignored.

Value

x, invisibly.

Details

The full specification is in x$pars, which can be printed directly. ctModelMatrices gives it as matrices.
